summary: TORM plc filed a Form 6-K containing two press releases, the principal one being a Danish Capital Markets Act section 30 major shareholder announcement. It discloses that OCM Njord Holdings S.à r.l., ultimately controlled by Brookfield Corporation, held 6,329,874 Class A shares equal to 6.17% of total share capital and voting rights as of September 23, 2026. A second release reports director and officer securities transactions. No transaction, offer, or board recommendation is stated; this is a routine ownership disclosure, not a special situation.
